category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, pair a lower Adam learning rate of 9e-4 with weak weight decay of 1e-6 to stabilize updates and mildly regularize parameters. Retain width 128, dropout 0.10, architecture, loss, predictor compatibility and training limits.

change_summary: Jointly tune Adam learning rate and weight decay for all four independent GRU4Rec models; no predictor changes are required.
